reason: I'd sign up for the free plan tonight and see if the sales co-worker actually chases my leads, but I'm not putting 99 € a month, or a year up front, on a promise. On 42k a year I need to see it give me hours back before I pay.
objection: Where does my customer data actually go and who can see it? Writing 'GDPR-compliant' on the page isn't enough. And I've no idea what 100 credits gets me. If it runs out mid-month I'm back to doing follow-ups at midnight.
would_change_my_mind: A free plan or trial where I watch it follow up a real lead from my CRM within a week, plus a plain explanation of where my data is stored (EU servers) and what one credit buys.
